title: Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers - VS Screen
description:
Heard the unsampled port by Hooded Edge and thought, hmm... What if I did this but sampled? So here we are.

Can be used in Pre-Boss Cutscenes.

Edit: Included an American version (i.e. Echo On), added light staccato and lowered the volume on the crash cymbal.
